'''Loyood''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] with a [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] personality who was a member of the [[Gorensla/Legends|Gorensla]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], one of the leading Hutt clans. During the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Loyood oversaw many of Gorensla's clandestine gun-running operations, including arms sales to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and other resistance groups. She made regular visits to the various [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowports]] in which Gorensla operated.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
